UPDATE track_stages
           SET status = 'pending', attempts = 0, redelivered = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL,
               last_error = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_class = NULL,
               evidence = '{"reason":"file changed"}'::jsonb,
               started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
           WHERE track_id = $1
